This is the documentation page for Module:Weapons/ppdata

Preprocessed version of Module:Weapons/data in the form of a lookup table. Contains top three values of a particular stat (e.g. crit chance) per weapon class (e.g. Arch-guns) and the weapons that have those values as well as the stat values that are boundaries for the following percentiles: 

90-100% - "Very high"
75-90% - "High"
60-75% - "Above average"
45-60% - "Average", does not display anything
30-45% - "Below average"
15-30% - "Low"
0-15% - "Very low"

This classification will be used on most Characteristics sections on weapon articles when comparing a weapon's advantages and disadvantages to other weapons in the same domain.

To update the database seeder script, go to Module:Weapons/preprocess.

See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison for the design document on this topic.
